dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Vietnamese cà phê is delicious, but too mạnh. I thích uống cà phê with milk more than drinking it black.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Milk iced cà phê is Vietnam's signature drink. I nghĩ it reflects Vietnamese character - mạnh but sweet.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: You nghĩ so? I find black cà phê truly shows real strength. We Russians thích nguyên bản things, not mixed.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: That's interesting. But I nghĩ mixing sometimes creates something more wonderful than the nguyên bản. Like my Vietnamese-American culture.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Maybe you're right... But I still thích uống cà phê my way. Have you ever wondered why we keep arguing about small things like cà phê?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Maybe because cà phê is just an excuse for us to talk to each other. I wonder if we actually care about something else?
